title: FUMI Salty Violet Nicotine Pouches
description: FUMi Salty Violet Nicotine Pouches offer a distinctive flavour pairing of floral-sweet Violet and gentle Liquorice. Unusual but accessible, this aromatic pouch is ideal for users who enjoy a more unconventional profile. The slim, all-white pouches fit discreetly under the lip and gradually release flavour and nicotine for up to 30 minutes. With no smoke, vapour or odour, they’re a clean and versatile choice for regular use. Choose from 4mg (Regular) or 8mg (Strong) strengths. Each can contains 20 pouches made from plant-based materials and produced to high standards by Helix AB in Sweden. Nicotine Range: Regular - 4mg this is best for new users. Extra Strong - 11mg this is suited for more experienced users. How To Use Nicotine Pouches: Please Note: DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
